build_dynamic_awq_mappings: build dynamic AWQ mappings for hybrid attention models like Qwen3Next and Qwen3.5
get_layer_mappings_from_model: get layer AWQ mappings from a model by checking dynamic registry, static registry, then defaults
detect_linear_attn_projections: detect linear attention projection names by inspecting model submodules for in_proj_* patterns
get_hybrid_attention_config: extract layer_types and num_hidden_layers from a hybrid attention model config
register_dynamic_mapping: register a dynamic AWQ mapping builder function for a model class name in the dynamic mapping registry
